DESCRIPTION OF PROJECT AND NATURE OF RFP 
 
30. Project. 
The City of Ashton is piloting a yearlong project to test the use an AI powered chatbot to enhance customer 
service delivery to it customers/residents utilizing the Ashton One-Call. Ashton One Call is the City’s 
centralized customer service center. This service allows residents to make inquiries, report issues and seek 
assistance related to City services. The goal of this project is to complement the existing communication 
channels with chatbot capabilities. 
40. Scope of Work. 
The City’s Ashton One-Call service is soliciting a vendor to provide and implement an AI Conversational Web 
Chatbot. This service will answer customers/residents seeking information about City services. It will deliver 
rule-based, conversational replies from predefined information approved sources of information, primarily, but 
not limited to the City website. This chatbot will be embedded into the City's website and accessible via pop-up 
or inline integration, enabling residents to engage via text, chat, and AI-driven conversation. 
 
The ideal solution should be flexible enough to adapt to new technologies or alternative systems as the City’s 
needs evolve. 
 
The City of Ashton expects that the successful vendor will provide the following: 
The chatbot will: 
• Answer FAQs using information from the City’s website and provide direct links when needed. 
• Handle customer support and help desk requests, covering a wide range of municipal services. 
• Recognize when a question is beyond its capabilities and provide alternative contact options. 
• Support multiple languages to enhance accessibility for diverse residents. 
• Allow residents to make inquiries, report issues, and request assistance related to City services. 
• Provide real-time updates in case of emergencies or service disruptions. 
 
The chatbot may include currently or as future enhancements such as: 
• Emergency/day-of updates can be made in cases of service delivery disruptions due to instances such 
as severe weather or holidays. 
• Actively supports multilingual requests with the same level of efficiency as English. 
• Omni-channel support, enabling integration with social media, email, and voice-based interactions. 
• Advanced AI learning capabilities to improve responses over time. 
• Integration with Cityworks platform to submit and track service requests automatically.

Project. The City of Ashton is piloting a yearlong project to test the use an AI powered chatbot to enhance customer service delivery to it customers/residents utilizing the Ashton One-Call. Ashton One Call is the City’s centralized customer service center. This service allows residents to make inquiries, report issues and seek assistance related to City services. The goal of this project is to complement the existing communication channels with chatbot capabilities. 40. Scope of Work. The City’s Ashton One-Call service is soliciting a vendor to provide and implement an AI Conversational Web Chatbot. This service will answer customers/residents seeking information about City services. It will deliver rule-based, conversational replies from predefined information approved sources of information, primarily, but not limited to the City website. This chatbot will be embedded into the City's website and accessible via pop-up or inline integration, enabling residents to engage via text, chat, and AI-driven conversation. The ideal solution should be flexible enough to adapt to new technologies or alternative systems as the City’s needs evolve. The City of Ashton expects that the successful vendor will provide the following: The chatbot will: • Answer FAQs using information from the City’s website and provide direct links when needed. • Handle customer support and help desk requests, covering a wide range of municipal services. • Recognize when a question is beyond its capabilities and provide alternative contact options. • Support multiple languages to enhance accessibility for diverse residents. • Allow residents to make inquiries, report issues, and request assistance related to City services. • Provide real-time updates in case of emergencies or service disruptions. The chatbot may include currently or as future enhancements such as: • Emergency/day-of updates can be made in cases of service delivery disruptions due to instances such as severe weather or holidays. • Actively supports multilingual requests with the same level of efficiency as English. • Omni-channel support, enabling integration with social media, email, and voice-based interactions. • Advanced AI learning capabilities to improve responses over time.
